Supreme Court Directs Petitioners to High Courts Over Bulldozers

The Supreme Court of India has directed petitioners to approach the high courts for resolving disputes related to bulldozers, following a petition challenging the use of these machines in demolishing homes. The court's decision aims to ensure that such actions are subject to judicial review and oversight.
